text:
priya: quick flag — SAST run on release/v1.8 returned 3 new findings after the RBAC changes in PR #4821. DAST also flagged a redirect on /auth/callback. Not critical but needs triage before canary.

michael: can you paste the SAST output? which files?

priya: copying the top lines from the scanner:```
SAST: HIGH src/auth/session_serializer.py:87 insecure-deserialize: use of pickle loads
SAST: MED src/payment/crypto_utils.py:42 hardcoded_key_detected
SAST: LOW tests/fixtures/api_keys.json: potential-credential (test-fixture)
```

alex: looks like two are false positives (test fixtures), but the insecure-deserialize is real. That serializer pulls arbitrary data from the cookie. We should switch to safe-json-serializer or add a allowlist.

sara: @priya can you add the security:triage label on the PR and assign the owners? I'll prep the security review checklist.

priya: done — labeled and assigned to @alex and @michael. Added PR note about staged rollout.

michael: FYI, the RBAC change in PR #4821 removed the `service:operator` binding for the auth-service role (requested by infra). Audit logs show a KMS.RotateKey event around the same time with missing principal_id for one event. Might be related to how the role change interacts with KMS IAM.

priya: sec-bot: run audit-log-check --resource KMS --from 2025-11-01 --to 2025-11-10 --event RotateKey

sec-bot: queued job 9932 — running audit-log-check. Results: 1/732 RotateKey events missing principalIdentity. Likely replication lag or delayed principal resolution. See /ops/logs/9932 (private link).

alex: can infra confirm whether the RBAC delta could cause missing principal metadata? If so we should revert binding until we understand.

michael: infra said the binding removal only affects impersonation scopes, but a misconfigured KMS grant could have caused the principal to be recorded as anonymous. I'll reach out to infra.

priya: re: secrets flagged — tests/fixtures is a test-only file; I'll add a suppression entry for the scanner (with reason: test fixture) and open a follow-up to rotate any real keys if present.

sara: also, DAST found an open redirect pattern: the callback flow allowed return_url param without host validation. That's medium severity for phishing. @alex can you run a quick fix to validate allowed hosts?

alex: yep. Will add a safe-host check and a unit + integration test. Also will add a small middleware to canonicalize callback URLs.

michael: proposed action items: 1) add security:triage label + owners (done), 2) hotfix PR to replace insecure deserialization (alex), 3) infra to verify KMS grants + audit config (sara + infra), 4) DAST re-run in staging with auth creds (priya), 5) suppress/whitelist test fixtures in SAST config (priya).

sara: I'll own #3 — coordinating with infra and ops. Also will add a blameless note to the canary playbook so rotations are paused during sensitive rollouts.

priya: timeline: aiming for patch and tests today, DAST re-run overnight, merge tomorrow morning if green.

michael: logging this triage to SECURITY-1294 and linking PR #4821. Will set a gating rule: no canary until DAST + SAST suppressions resolved.

priya: sec-bot: comment PR 4821 "security triage recorded: SECURITY-1294. Fixes required before canary."

sec-bot: comment posted on PR #4821. Policy check: PR blocked for missing security-review signoff. Use /security-approve to request an expedited review.

priya: /security-approve — requesting signoff.

sara: I'll review after lunch. If high-risk, we'll request oncall.

michael: one more note — KMS key rotation schedule overlaps with our planned canary windows. Recommend infra pause automatic rotations for 48h while this lands.

infra-bot: maintenance freeze applied for 48h starting now (no scheduled KMS rotations).

alex: thanks — I'll open the serializer hotfix PR and ping this thread when ready.

priya: updating thread: attached DAST screenshot in PR and added repro steps. Will also include a safe-deserialize migration plan. :thumbsup: 

michael: thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for triage notes. If anything changes, post here or @sec-oncall.
